name: umask
summary: Set the default file creation permission mask.
description: Set or display the file mode creation mask used by the shell for newly created files and directories.

options.description: Print the mask in symbolic form.
Print the mask in a reusable shell command form.

examples.title: Display the current mask
examples.explanation: Shows the octal mask applied to new files and directories.

examples.title: Use a private default
examples.explanation: Makes newly created files private to the current user by default.

examples.title: Inspect symbolic permissions
examples.explanation: Displays the effective default permission mask symbolically.
